subject: spanish
title: El Subjuntivo
welcome_lead: The subjunctive marks HL Spanish. It expresses doubt, emotion, hope, and non-realised actions.
meta_desc: Spanish grammar: subjunctive mood for HL writing.
final_note: El subjuntivo es el modo de lo posible.

concepts.def: That I be — present subjunctive of ser.
That I have — present subjunctive of tener.
It is necessary that — triggers subjunctive.

walkthroughs.body_html: Reverse the vowel: -ar verbs take -e endings, -er/-ir take -a. Hablar > hable; comer > coma; vivir > viva.
Es necesario que, quiero que, espero que, para que, antes de que, sin que, a menos que, ojala.
Quiero que vengas. Es importante que estudies. Ojala llueva manana.

sequence.def: Pluperfect: before another past moment — earliest here
Preterite: a completed trip last year
Near future (ir a + infinitive): this summer
Simple future: next year — the latest here
